description: This file defines the interface MessageSender in the package org.eclipse.hono.client, which provides methods for sending AMQP messages to a specified endpoint within the Hono platform. It includes method signatures for sending messages, closing the sender, and obtaining the endpoint name, along with support for tracing via OpenTracing's SpanContext.

classes.name: MessageSender
classes.description: An interface for sending AMQP messages to a specific endpoint in Hono, supporting various delivery semantics, closure, and tracing.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint this sender publishes messages to, which is implementation specific.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the AMQP link to the server, invoking the provided handler upon completion.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the sender is currently open and able to send messages.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message asynchronously, returning a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Default method that sends an AMQP message with optional OpenTracing context, returning a Future.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message and waits for the disposition outcome from the peer.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Default method that sends a message and waits for its outcome, with optional tracing context.
